authority: Offline art construction and review only; no gameplay, collision, timing, stats or runtime-registry authority.
scale_policy: One immutable body scale across all actions; page-wide source calibration only, never per-pose fitting or anatomy warping.
head_measurement: Ordinary cranium excludes hair, fins, horns, wings and ancestry crowns.
yaw_convention: South/front is 0; increasing yaw proceeds S, SE, E, NE, N, NW, W, SW. These are art-facing targets, not simulation angle units.

directions.cue: Centered front chest, both shoulders balanced, nose and feet toward camera; not diagonal.
Front-right three-quarter; chest and near cheek visible, shoulders staggered, near hand/leg overlap; neither square front nor right profile.
True right profile; nose, knees and toes point screen-right; far shoulder/limbs overlap behind near side.
Rear-right three-quarter; back and rear skull dominate, no frontal chest or full visible face; right shoulder and rightward toe/heel axis; not right profile.
Centered full back, rear skull and both shoulders balanced; no face or chest; heels toward viewer.
Rear-left three-quarter; back and rear skull dominate, no frontal chest or full visible face; left shoulder and leftward toe/heel axis; not left profile.
True left profile; nose, knees and toes point screen-left; far shoulder/limbs overlap behind near side.
Front-left three-quarter; chest and near cheek visible, shoulders staggered, near hand/leg overlap; neither square front nor left profile.

contact_policy: Anatomical left/right, never screen-left/right. A/B visibly exchange planted and passing legs, with opposite arm counter-swing. Costume mirroring, moved toes, whole-body translations and different pixel hashes do not establish a second contact.

source_board.pair_layout: Place walk beside walk_b and sprint beside sprint_b. Preserve a neutral calibration pose on each source board.

portrait.crop: Exactly the top third of occupied south-grounded bounds: all occupied width and ceil(occupied_height/3) rows, fitted into a transparent32px portrait. No separate manual portrait artwork.
portrait.authority: Presentation only; does not alter atlas geometry.

pixel_policy: Binary alpha, transparent gutters, nearest sampling, no mipmaps, no filtered sprite edges. Reviewed source-hash-locked matte extraction only; retain immutable originals and masks.
reuse_policy: Share size guides, landmarks, camera, facing/contact grammar and registration; do not reuse another champion's identity pixels as unique art. No new live paper-doll renderer.
review_gate: Exact candidate PNG SHA plus all80 reviewed cells and opposite locomotion contacts; explicit held/pending cells block new promotion. Technical validation checks the attestation, not anatomy or visual quality. Existing live pages are not disabled by absent retrospective receipts.
